feature_reviews.notes: All four original C paths identify roles, n0 maxima, the p1 n3 red block and p1 n2 uniformity. Their original display_or_sensor_property scopes are preserved in the evidence inventory. The data themselves are supplied estimates/records, not measurements of felt or physical appearance. Original evidence metadata, unchanged (duplicate paths are not collapsed): [{"evidence": {"attribute": "roles", "end": 75, "quote": "red and blue roles", "referent": "roles", "scope": "display_or_sensor_property", "start": 57, "time": "current"}, "path": ["features", "C", "evidence", 0]}, {"evidence": {"attribute": "location_peaks", "end": 346, "quote": "blue peaks at [0,2], red at [0,0]", "referent": "panel p0 n0", "scope": "display_or_sensor_property", "start": 313, "time": "current"}, "path": ["features", "C", "evidence", 1]}, {"evidence": {"attribute": "location_peaks", "end": 644, "quote": "red peaks on the opposite 2x2 block {[0,2],[0,3],[1,2],[1,3]}", "referent": "panel p1 n3 red", "scope": "display_or_sensor_property", "start": 583, "time": "current"}, "path": ["features", "C", "evidence", 2]}, {"evidence": {"attribute": "uniform_distribution", "end": 523, "quote": "n2 uniform", "referent": "panel p1 n2", "scope": "display_or_sensor_property", "start": 513, "time": "current"}, "path": ["features", "C", "evidence", 3]}]

Evidence 0 names isolated red/blue peak coordinates at p0 n0; coordinates/maxima alone do not establish O. Evidence 1 explicitly describes uniform organization across all 16 cells at p0 n2. Evidence 2 states a 2x2 peak block at p1 n3. The latter two express spatial patterns under the limited model-organization transfer, so the global O feature has support, while the isolated peak-coordinate item does not independently qualify. Original evidence metadata, unchanged (duplicate paths are not collapsed): [{"evidence": {"attribute": "presentation_peaks", "end": 346, "quote": "blue peaks at [0,2], red at [0,0]", "referent": "panel p0 n0", "scope": "model_organization", "start": 313, "time": "current"}, "path": ["features", "O", "evidence", 0]}, {"evidence": {"attribute": "presentation_uniform", "end": 415, "quote": "n2 both roles uniform across all 16 cells", "referent": "panel p0 n2", "scope": "model_organization", "start": 374, "time": "current"}, "path": ["features", "O", "evidence", 1]}, {"evidence": {"attribute": "presentation_block_peaks", "end": 581, "quote": "blue peaks on the 2x2 block {[0,0],[0,1],[1,0],[1,1]}", "referent": "panel p1 n3 blue", "scope": "model_organization", "start": 528, "time": "current"}, "path": ["features", "O", "evidence", 2]}]

D evidence 0 supplies generic provenance/nonexecution, and evidence 1 reports alternative conditional maxima/probabilities. Neither separates the p0 n2 identified content from its organization/presentation/access status. Conditionality is a forecast/source distinction and changed probabilities alone are excluded by D. Thus the original explicit global D has unsupported grounding under the unchanged reference. Original evidence metadata, unchanged (duplicate paths are not collapsed): [{"evidence": {"attribute": "record_provenance_status", "end": 259, "quote": "Origins: copied prior records are not new updates; conditional command records are hypothetical branches, not executed events.", "referent": "origins/records", "scope": "unclear", "start": 133, "time": "current"}, "path": ["features", "D", "evidence", 0]}, {"evidence": {"attribute": "alternative_distribution_status", "end": 887, "quote": "Candidate (k0,k1,k2) records show alternative conditional distributions per node and role; where present they differ in which cells carry the maximum probability (as enumerated in propositions) and in peak probabilities reported in the data.", "referent": "candidate records", "scope": "unclear", "start": 646, "time": "current"}, "path": ["features", "D", "evidence", 1]}]
